history.title: Georgia adopts the State Seal of Biliteracy
history.description: Senate Bill 48 (2016) added O.C.G.A. § 20-2-159.5 directing GADOE to administer a Seal of Biliteracy on the high-school diploma for graduates demonstrating proficiency in English plus one or more additional languages. GADOE administers the program through districts.

history.title: EPAA 29(100) document analysis (Leider, Colombo & Nerlino, 2021)
history.description: Leider, Colombo & Nerlino published in Education Policy Analysis Archives 29(100) a comprehensive document analysis of every state and DC's bilingual, ELD/ESL, and SEI teacher-credentialing requirements, professional teaching standards mentions, and EL-percentage figures, based on primary SEA sources collected October–December 2019. The 2019 coding of Georgia's EL-credentialing landscape is preserved as a temporally-anchored research baseline against which the catalog's later verifications are framed.

history.title: GaPSC Rule 505-3-.89 (ESOL EPP standards) effective
history.description: Revised ESOL Educator Preparation Program standards take effect August 15, 2023. Combined with Rule 505-2-.14 (endorsements) and the 2026-effective Rule 505-2-.166 (ESOL endorsement certification), this is Georgia's current rule architecture for the ESOL credential.

history.title: GaPSC Rule 505-2-.166 (ESOL Endorsement) effective
history.description: Revised ESOL Endorsement Certification rule takes effect, restating the approved-program-plus-test pathway to the ESOL endorsement (field code 825) on a primary teaching certificate. The standalone ESOL field (885) remains in the P-12 Fields list per GaPSC's January 2026 Certificate Field Codes sheet.
